name: Hedgedoc
description: HedgeDoc gives you access to all your files wherever you are.
short_desc: HedgeDoc gives you access to all your files wherever you are
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: DB_PORT
form_fields.hint: Port to access mariadb database default is 3306

form_fields.label: CMD_DOMAIN
form_fields.hint: The address the gui will be accessed at (ie. 192.168.1.1 or hedgedoc.domain.com).

form_fields.label: CMD_URL_ADDPORT
form_fields.hint: Set to true if using a port other than 80 or 443.

form_fields.label: CMD_PROTOCOL_USESSL
form_fields.hint: Set to true if accessing over https via reverse proxy.

form_fields.label: CMD_PORT
form_fields.hint: If you wish to access hedgedoc at a port different than 80, 443 or 3000, you need to set this to that port (ie. CMDPORT=5000) and change the port mapping accordingly (5000:5000).

form_fields.label: CMD_DB_DIALECT
form_fields.hint: This variable allows selecting a database engine (if DBHOST not set up). Available options are: mariadb, mysql, postgres, sqlite.
